item.title: T1K 0.1.7
item.description:
• Triggers (Settings › Triggers): when a tab prints a match (including what Claude Code draws), an agent needs you or a command fails, run actions, or ask with buttons and a default after a timeout. Actions include running a command in a new pane, or in the background with its exit status and last lines kept. The helper can write the pattern from a description.
  • What you typed but didn't send comes back after a restart: into the shell once its prompt is ready, or into Claude once the session has resumed and shows its input.
  • Windows: each shows its name, ⌘O groups tabs by window, the Dock icon brings forward the window that has waited longest, and ⌘Q asks once for every window.
  • Outputs: everything but PRs takes one line, the panel can be dragged wider, and the PR section says when status was last fetched, with a refresh for all of them.
  • Links can open with a plain click (Settings › Tabs & Links).
  • Quick terminal slides in and out, follows the window's opacity, and asks before ⌘W ends its shell.

item.title: T1K 0.1.6
item.description:
• Windows: ⌘N opens another window with its own tabs. Move a tab from its menu or drag its row out of the window. ⌘J, the Dock badge and Needs you cover every window.
  • Panes: up to four per tab (⌘D right, ⌘⇧D down), with headers, draggable dividers, ⌘⇧↵ to zoom one, and ⌘⌥ arrows to move between them.
  • Panes: an agent in a split pane that asks for you or hits an error shows on its tab's row and in Needs you, with which pane; ⌘J lands on that pane. Closing a pane with a program running asks first.
  • Quick terminal (off by default, Settings › Quick terminal): a shortcut that works in any app shows the tab that needs you in a floating panel, so you answer in place; with nothing waiting it is a quick shell.
  • Broadcast input: type once into every pane of a tab (⌥⌘I), a group's tabs or tabs you pick. Agent tabs get whole prompts from a compose bar; password prompts pause it and multi-line pastes ask first.
  • Watching: a Claude tab that finished its turn but will carry on by itself (background agents, a monitor, a scheduled wake-up) says so, with a countdown, instead of looking done.
  • Context details: click a Claude tab's context meter for what fills its context window, and Details for the full breakdown, compactions, session totals and loaded tools in the panel's new Context tab.
  • Tabs sort by when they last changed state, newest first, so rows no longer jump on every status change (group menu › Sort tabs by, to go back to Needs attention).
  • Group colors are a pastel rainbow, in rainbow order down the sidebar, and the Outputs panel colors its sections the same way.
  • Secure Keyboard Entry turns on by itself while the terminal you type in asks for a password (Settings › Advanced to turn that off).
  • Outputs: tickets from GitLab, Shortcut, Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Azure Boards, YouTrack, Sentry and self-hosted Jira are listed, each with its mark.
  • Outputs: an artifact made from a type (slides, a design canvas, a doc, a dashboard, motion) shows that type's icon.
  • Fix: ⌘V with an image on the clipboard (a screenshot, Copy Image) attaches it in Claude Code, as in iTerm2 and Warp.

item.title: T1K 0.1.5
item.description:
• Notifications from any program: OSC 9 and OSC 777 messages show as macOS notifications and mark their tab unread.
  • Column selection: hold ⌥ and drag to select a block of text.
  • Kitty keyboard protocol, so programs that ask for it can tell ⇧↵ from ↵ and ctrl+i from tab, and see key releases and lone modifier keys.
  • Secure Keyboard Entry (Settings › Advanced): while T1K is in front, other apps can't read what you type.
  • The selected tab is outlined in its group's color, around the row and the terminal it opens (Settings › Interface to turn it off).
  • Background opacity and blur (Settings › Appearance › Window).
  • ⌘⇧C copies the last command's output, and hovering a finished command shows Copy output and Copy command (needs shell integration).
  • ⌘Z undoes typing in Claude Code, zsh and bash; while a "Moved…" notice shows, it undoes the tab move, and that notice now stays 12 seconds.
  • Clicking to move the cursor works across the lines of Claude's multi-line input.
  • Outputs: long sessions fold to the newest 5 per section with "+N more"; open PRs always show, merged and closed ones take one quiet line.
  • Outputs: files that no longer exist move behind an "N deleted" row.
  • Outputs: text files open in the preview panel, which now has a Default app button.
  • Outputs: reopened sessions keep their whole list, with the times things happened.
  • Outputs: tickets show their tracker's mark (Linear, Jira, GitHub), icons are bigger, and copying is an icon.
  • Quitting can be cancelled while programs stop, and every Claude session the quit closed resumes next launch.
  • Fix: closing an idle Claude tab goes to the neighbor your setting asks for, not the last tab in its group.
  • Fix: a Claude tab stuck on Working after a turn ended without a reply goes back to Idle.
  • Fix: a path printed before its file existed becomes a link once the file is there.
  • Fix: no empty space at the bottom of a tab after a program redraws a short screen.

item.title: T1K 0.1.4
item.description:
• Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and Grok tabs show their own mark in the sidebar.
  • Outputs: files and docs show an icon for their type (code, data, images, archives, Google Docs, Slides, Sheets...), and docs say where they live.
  • Outputs: a scrollbar when the list is taller than the panel.
  • Outputs: names and descriptions use the full row; Show and Copy appear on hover.

item.title: T1K 0.1.3
item.description:
• Hover a web link and the pointer turns into a hand.
  • Scrolling back after a long line was replaced moves smoothly from what you saw, instead of jumping to empty rows first; the scrollbar and the top of history match.

item.title: T1K 0.1.2
item.description: • ⌘Q from the keyboard asks about running tabs again, instead of quitting right away.

item.title: T1K 0.1.1
item.description:
• Bring your tabs over from Warp, iTerm2, Terminal, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm and tmux; Claude sessions resume where they were.
  • "Same font as in Warp?": match your old terminal's font, size, spacing and colors in one click, with Undo.
  • Set up T1K: a short walk through the settings people miss, from the welcome card, the T1K menu, Settings or the palette.
  • Tabs come back after a quit or an update with their scrollback, and Claude sessions resume; the sidebar says what's still coming back.
  • Plan usage limits for Claude, Codex and Antigravity in a small meter, and the context meter now uses Claude's own numbers.
  • Group colors, icons and order; groups of your own; drag tabs and groups between groups with Undo; close a tab or a whole group from the sidebar.
  • Tab icons can be an emoji, any app's icon or an image; a Claude session's /color shows on its tab.
  • The outputs panel shows PR titles, checks and review state, and artifacts by type and title.
  • Get more fonts: install free coding fonts from the font picker, checked against their official releases.
  • A scrollbar that shows while you scroll, with prompt and find marks, and a scroll-to-bottom button that counts new lines (⌘⇧↓).
  • Drop files on a terminal to type their paths; ⌘ + click opens links, and resting on one says so.
  • ⌘J says when nothing needs you and offers the newest unread tab; ⌥ shows what a row isn't already showing.
  • Choose where new tabs open and where closing a tab takes you.
  • Report a bug fills in the GitHub issue with your versions, settings and recent errors.
  • Quitting from the Dock now asks about running tabs, like ⌘Q.
  • More contrast in Mercury Dark, a steel-blue app icon, and many smaller fixes.

item.title: T1K 0.1.0
item.description:
• First public release: a native macOS terminal for running many coding agents at once.
  • Sidebar groups tabs by project and shows each agent's status, goal and recap; tabs that need you rise to the top, and ⌘J jumps to them.
  • Works with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Gemini CLI and Grok through their hooks.
  • ⌘P switcher, ⌘O overview, outputs panel (PRs, files, links), reminders with snooze.
  • 20 built-in themes plus import from Ghostty, iTerm2, Alacritty, Windows Terminal and base16, with a live-preview picker.
  • Resizable sidebar that collapses to a strip of icons or hides; every shortcut can be rebound.
  • Optional cheap-model helper for titles, recaps and search by meaning (off by default).
